snippet.title: Solar Goat
snippet.description:
I’m Brandan Sirrine, a solar technician with over 10 years of hands-on field experience fixing the systems most companies walk away from. Here, I show you the truth about solar — what breaks, why it breaks, and how to fix it.

This channel is for homeowners, technicians, and anyone who’s tired of the “maintenance-free” myth.
You’ll learn:
⚡ How to diagnose inverter, optimizer, and wiring issues
⚡ How to get your system back online and producing
⚡ How to keep your panels working long-term — without the sales pitch

From burnt connectors to warranty fights, I show what really happens on rooftops every day.

Subscribe for weekly videos on solar diagnostics, maintenance, and chaos — because if you own solar…
your panels might be broken too. ⚡🐐

snippet.title: Good Faith Energy
snippet.description:
Good Faith Energy is a home-grown, top-rated solar provider based in North Texas. 
Founded in 2014 by CEO, Mohammed Abdalla, motivated by the substantial need for quality renewable energy solutions and a strong commitment to a healthier planet. 
At Good Faith Energy, we believe in the importance of educating our customers and providing them the necessary tools that allow them to fully manage their energy consumption, production, and storage. 
Our energy management solutions focus on a holistic approach to reduce building consumption, meet that consumption with on-site renewable energy, and store that on-site renewable energy for times where savings can be maximized or the grid is facing reliability challenges.
We are your local experts on solar installations, roofing, energy efficiency and management, electric vehicle charging stations, and back-up battery systems. 
Together with Good Faith Energy, we promise you a smarter, safer, and more reliable energy future.

snippet.title: Off-Grid Backcountry Adventures
snippet.description:
Full-Time Truck Camping Nomad From 2015-2021, Now Living Off-Grid In Northern AZ On 14 Acres
Hello, my name is Brian and I have been camping full-time in my 4x4 Tacoma since July 5th, 2015 slaying dragons on the reg. I decided to ditch my former Corporate Life due to all the stress and sleepless nights I encountered from the rat race. Traveling full-time has been such an incredible experience and through this channel I want to inspire others to do the same. My videos provide insight into all aspects of 4x4 vehicle travel and offer advice on what gear to use to help make your adventures comfortable. If you have any questions on my videos then please add a comment and I'll do my best to get back to you in a timely manner. Please keep in mind that I spend about 2 weeks per month offline so my response time may be somewhat slow but I do promise to respond to each inquiry. For additional information on my efforts, please check out my website at www.OffGridBackcountryAdventures.com.

snippet.title: Green
snippet.description:
In a world clouded by the shadows of economic crises and climate change, it’s easy to believe that making a positive impact with your actions is like holding up an umbrella in a meteor shower.

We get it, but fear not! The shining light of change is easier to harness than you might think.

Enter solar, the not-so-secret-weapon to help you see the end of financial and environmental doom and gloom. And no, we’re not talking about pointing your buns to the sun, so keep your pants on and take off that foil hat.

Adding solar to your roof, harnessing renewable energy, saving on your energy bill and doing your bit for the planet might all sound like coo-coo talk if you’re not on the train to transformation, but you can be certain that even the smallest change will generate positive impact.

You don’t need to live off the land, start hugging trees or walking around without your shoes on - but going green sure is a step in the right direction for our planet and your pockets.

Just go Green.

snippet.title: Eau Gallie Electric, Inc.
snippet.description: Eau Gallie Electric, Inc. is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned small business located in sunny Melbourne, Florida.  We have been around since 1948 supporting all of Central Florida's residential and commercial electrical needs.  We specialize in generator installation and repair, electrical service work, NAVAIDS, UPS installation and upgrades, and electrical construction projects.  Our vision is to provide superior service through high-quality electrical solutions.  Our driving forces are integrity and faith.  We maintain a set of core values that we use as the foundation for our company: cleanliness, neat work, high-quality, and attention to detail are hallmarks of our service.  We value our customers and our employees as the backbone of our business and our mission will always be to answer God's call to change lives.

snippet.title: Minute Man Solar
snippet.description:
Solar can be complicated. I aim to help simplify it so anyone can enjoy the savings and benefits of using the sun's free energy. Whether it's for backup power for emergencies to run essentials, off-grid power for a cabin or RV, grid-tied power to save on electricity bills, or running anything on solar, such as crypto miners, EVs, well pumps, and much more.

Solar can be easy. I call it Simply Complicated. Once it's explained in a simple way, it's easy to understand and use it. 

I aim to help people save money, be self-reliant, and have all the power they need anywhere they go.

My goals are to create, teach, and help.

snippet.title: The Passive House Files
snippet.description:
For generations, homes were built to heat, cool, and power
themselves — no HVAC, no utility company, no monthly bill.
Then cheap energy arrived, and we quietly forgot how.

This channel brings those methods back.

📄 How to Cut Your Energy Bills Toward Zero:
https://passive-house-files.netlify.app

The earth loops. The ground tunnels. The sun on your roof.
The water past your land. These aren't lost secrets — they're
documented, proven building methods, still working today, and
almost nobody builds with them anymore.

I'm Bas Beckers, and the Passive House Files is a record of
those methods — heating, cooling, and off-grid power — explained
step by step, with real numbers and honest results, for any home
you already own.

No miracle gadgets. No hype. No "free energy" scams. Just the
real, low-tech ways to make a home stand on its own.

New build. Every video.

Subscribe if you want to understand what the energy industry
stopped showing you how to do.

snippet.title: Regen Power Australia
snippet.description:
Established in 2003 Regen Power is a National company providing renewable energy products and services to residential, commercial and off -grid mining and remote community markets, with a vision to create affordable access to power through sustainable solutions and innovative technologies.
Some of the major strengths of the company include that it has undertaken research and development approved by AusIndustry, has collaborative links with The University of Western Australia, Curtin University and the University of Tasmania, and has completed more than 30,000 residential and commercial installations in Australia.
Regen Power’s contribution has been instrumental in commercialising renewable energy power systems to regular households at affordable prices.
Key components of its success are its quality products and services, affordable pricing, ongoing innovation, and futuristic approach.

snippet.title: GoSun
snippet.description:
Living off-grid or having plenty of power has never been easier. Whether you are a boater, RVer, love fishing, sailing, camping, van life, or want to live more independent, GoSun has a product you will love. . GoSun has developed breakthrough solar technologies that can cook, cool, light, charge, or purify using only the Sun.  And now our all electric boats and off grid trailers are available for rent, for adventures and fun. 
Founded in a garage in Cincinnati, Ohio, we grew quickly thanks to our community of committed customers and shareholders. Since our inception, we've worked with nonprofits to provide solar products to those in need. GoSun has provided funding and support to the American Red Cross, World Central Kitchen, Houston Food Bank, Global Giving, Operation BBQ Relief, Hawaii Salvation Army and the California Community Wildfire Relief Fund. GoSun has also donated to several Ukrainian relief organizations including Direct Relief, International Rescue Committee, and Unicef.
